apps.versionDescription: Playback forced to the loudspeaker (the port enables mic recording, which routed all sound to the earpiece), render scale 0.7, version string bumped to 0.3. Photon multiplayer untouched.
apps.localizedDescription: R.E.P.O. iOS port by GLEPorts, patched: iOS audio no longer plays through the earpiece, render scale lowered to 0.7, bundle version 0.3. Multiplayer config (Photon app id, version, RPC list) is byte-identical to the Android 0.3 build, so cross-play still works.
